newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan coffee prices up on good quality.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan coffee prices up on good quality.

text.p: Kenyan coffee prices rose, building on a rally last week and boosted by the good quality coffee on offer at the weekly auction on Tuesday, auction officials said.
"Prices advanced for all grades but there was an additional premium on good quality," the Coffee Board of Kenya said.
Grade Cs averaged $236.5 per 50-kg from $230.5 last week while grade ABs averaged $250 from $244.5. Grade PBs averaged $248.5 from $239.5.
"Prices were up again following the New York market," a trader said.
